profile.headline: Senior Lead Data Analyst | Business Analytics | Decision Science | Banking | Business Analysis | Data Governance | Executive Reporting | AI Adoption
profile.jobTitle: Senior Lead Data Analyst / Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary:
With more than 25 years of experience in technology, data analytics, and business transformation, I help organizations turn complex data into actionable business decisions.
 
Throughout my career, I've partnered with Fortune 100 financial institutions to lead enterprise analytics initiatives, modernize reporting, improve data quality, and deliver solutions that enable executive decision-making. My experience spans banking, regulatory reporting, business intelligence, data governance, technology risk, and cross-functional program leadership.
 
I enjoy solving complex business problems by combining strong analytical thinking with practical execution. Whether leading enterprise reporting initiatives, translating business requirements into technical solutions, implementing governance processes, or driving AI adoption, I focus on delivering measurable business value while building strong relationships across technology and business teams.
 
My areas of expertise include:
 • Business & Data Analytics
 • SQL & Data Engineering
 • Executive Reporting & Data Visualization
 • Business Analysis & Requirements Gathering
 • Data Governance & Quality
 • Regulatory & Banking Analytics
 • Project & Program Leadership
 • AI Adoption & Process Improvement
 • Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management
 
I believe the best analytics don't just explain what happened—they help organizations make better decisions about what to do next.
 
I'm always interested in connecting with professionals who are passionate about analytics, data strategy, business transformation, and emerging technologies.

positions.title: Senior Lead Data Analyst / Lead Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Lead enterprise analytics and technology initiatives supporting Vulnerability Remediation and Reporting. Partner with business leaders, application owners, cybersecurity teams, and global technology partners to deliver reporting, automation, and data-driven solutions that improve operational decision-making and regulatory readiness.
• Lead cross-functional initiatives supporting enterprise vulnerability remediation, reporting, and operational governance.
• Serve as the primary data and reporting SME, partnering with business and technology stakeholders to define requirements and deliver actionable analytics.
• Develop complex SQL queries, reporting solutions, and executive dashboards that provide visibility into enterprise technology risk and remediation progress.
• Translate business requirements into technical solutions, improving reporting accuracy and operational efficiency.
• Lead data analysis, validation, and root cause investigations to support strategic decision-making and issue resolution.
• Drive AI adoption as a Copilot Champion by developing prompt libraries, identifying enterprise use cases, and promoting AI best practices across technical teams.
• Led Phase 1 of a ServiceNow Vulnerability Response integration initiative, coordinating multiple subject matter experts and aligning business and technical requirements.
• Prepare executive-level presentations, performance metrics, and reporting packages for senior leadership.
• Collaborate with global teams using Agile methodologies to deliver high-impact technology and analytics initiatives.

positions.title: Lead Data Analyst
positions.description:
• Successfully implemented data quality standards and best practices, ensuring accuracy and reliability in analytical outputs for the Community Reinvestment Act (CRA). 
• Defined and led detailed research on business and technology requests to develop efficient and accurate functional requirements.
• Adapted quickly to evolving project requirements and deadlines, maintaining a high level of flexibility within the agile Kanban framework. 
• Participated in Agile activities including: daily standup, refinement, big room planning, story writing.
• Collaborated and consulted with business and development teams to deliver technological solutions to complex business problems.
• Utilized advanced level SQL ad hoc query writing and data warehouse skills 
• Created controls for existing processes
• Regularly engaged in retrospective meetings to evaluate team performance and identify opportunities for process optimization. 
• Produced actionable reports and visualizations to communicate findings effectively to stakeholders and support decision-making processes. 
• Provided production support and managed user engagement. Investigate user issues in reporting, automation and Power BI reports.
• Created team documentation in confluence.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to define user stories, acceptance criteria, and release goals for data analysis initiatives.
• Writing Adhoc SQL Queries (Oracle, Teradata), AB Testing

positions.title: Senior Technical Analyst/Project Manager Level IV
positions.description:
• As part of the Engagement and Transitions team in Enterprise Business Intelligence Technology (EBIT), I was responsible for engagement for more than 100,000 internal clients 
• The BI Tools include: Tableau, Cognos and MicroStrategy 
• Managed the project to create attestations for the EBIT user community. Met with leadership from each BI platform to analyze pain points and potential risks the teams were experiencing due to improper use of the systems. Analyzed currently policies for supporting detail and wrote policies and guidelines that the internal customers should follow while using their products. 
• Team process documentation 
• Created team presentations, charts and diagrams for communication with upper management 
• Created process for approving or denying user software exception requests 
• Advanced ad hoc SQL Query writing

positions.title: Senior Technical Analyst
positions.description:
• Operated within a dynamic small business setting, strategically expanding client base, enhancing business visibility, and extending business outreach.
• Spearheaded the automation of workflows encompassing email correspondence, data acquisition, and social media marketing, streamlining operational efficiencies and enhancing productivity.
• Conducted instructional sessions on automation techniques, empowering individuals with the knowledge and skills required to optimize their business processes.
• Proficiently utilized data management query tools to extract actionable insights and facilitate informed decision-making processes.
• Conceptualized and engineered IT solutions tailored to the unique needs of small businesses, optimizing operational workflows and enhancing overall efficiency.
• Developed comprehensive training curricula for entrepreneurs seeking to leverage digital content creation and automation tools to scale their online ventures.
• Established and documented robust processes and procedures to standardize operations and enhance organizational efficiency.
• Led the design and implementation of new company databases, ensuring scalability, security, and optimal performance.
• Played a pivotal role in creating job roles and facilitating the recruitment process, contributing to the acquisition of skilled personnel essential for business growth.
• Designed and implemented automation solutions to streamline business operations, reduce manual intervention, and enhance overall efficiency.
• Leveraged advanced SQL query development techniques to extract, analyze, and visualize data, facilitating informed decision-making processes and supporting business objectives.

positions.title: Senior Technical Analyst
positions.description:
• Compiled and generated reports tailored for the marketing team, providing crucial insights to drive strategic decision-making and optimize marketing efforts.
• Leveraged data management query tools proficiently to extract, manipulate, and analyze data, facilitating informed decision-making processes and supporting business objectives.
• Executed Oracle database queries utilizing T-SQL, ensuring efficient data retrieval and manipulation to meet various business requirements.
• Prepared and delivered monthly reports for a proprietary credit scoring system, providing key stakeholders with comprehensive insights into creditworthiness and risk assessment.
• Contributed to reporting efforts for upper management, delivering concise and informative reports to facilitate strategic planning and decision-making at the executive level.
• Analyzed risk data to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, identifying and mitigating potential risks to safeguard organizational integrity.
• Demonstrated proficiency in advanced ad hoc SQL query writing, enabling the extraction of actionable insights from complex datasets to support data-driven decision-making.
• Developed SQL stored procedures to streamline data processing and enhance efficiency in database operations, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.

positions.title: Technical Analyst
positions.description:
• Led a dynamic, fast paced online marketing campaign along with marketing consultants, overseeing their performance, fostering a collaborative environment, and nurturing their talents to enhance their capabilities and drive collective growth.
• Worked with the global paid advertising team to optimize future marketing campaigns by analyzing data from ad campaigns.
• Initiated and executed a comprehensive program to centralize company-wide data into structured data warehouses, enabling the creation of impactful reports using Power BI. These reports provided valuable insights into the efficacy of new strategies and facilitated the monitoring of customer base growth.
• Implemented scalable initiatives to optimize website traffic, increase downloads, registrations, and signups, driving measurable improvements in user engagement and conversion rates.

positions.title: Lead Technical Analyst
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented automated workflows tailored specifically for small businesses, encompassing a range of functionalities including email automation, data aggregation, social media management, text marketing, reporting, and website design. These automated processes streamlined operations and enhanced productivity for small business owners.
• Demonstrated expertise in advanced ad hoc SQL query writing, enabling the extraction, manipulation, and analysis of complex datasets to derive actionable insights and support data-driven decision-making for technical initiatives.
• Provided instructional classes on automation techniques, sharing insights and best practices to empower individuals with the knowledge and skills necessary to implement and manage automated processes effectively. These classes facilitated the adoption of automation technologies and fostered a culture of innovation within the organization.

positions.title: Technical Business Analyst
positions.description:
• Proficient in MicroStrategy, Cognos, SSRS, SharePoint, InfoPath, and Spotfire development, leveraging these platforms to design and develop robust business intelligence solutions.
• Managed application defect resolution processes, ensuring the timely identification, prioritization, and resolution of issues to maintain system integrity and functionality.
• Created SSRS reports integrating data from Teradata, SQL Server, and Oracle databases, delivering comprehensive insights and analytics to support decision-making processes.
• Demonstrated expertise in data management, including the creation and automation of reporting processes to meet compliance and regulatory requirements.
• Collaborated closely with the Business Intelligence team and user community during User Acceptance Testing (UAT) phases to ensure solutions met user requirements and expectations.
• Documented data lineage to track data sources and transformations, ensuring transparency and accuracy in reporting processes.
• Possessed experience in Anti-Money Laundering policies, facilitating compliance with regulatory requirements and mitigating financial risks.
• Developed metrics reporting based on Key Risk Indicators and Key Performance Indicators, providing insights into organizational performance/risk exposure.
• Documented system processes for the production support team, ensuring comprehensive documentation of procedures/workflows.
• Participated in the development of ETL processes to facilitate data integration/management.
• Optimized queries to improve performance and efficiency in data retrieval/analysis processes.
• Developed stored procedures, functions, and views to enhance database functionality/support reporting requirements.
• Merrill Lynch transition projects, facilitating smooth transitions/minimizing disruptions to business operations.
• Served on the Production Support Team for the Enterprise Referrals Application, providing technical support and troubleshooting assistance as needed.
